name: auth_rls_initplan
title: Auth RLS Initialization Plan
description: Detects if calls to `current_setting()` and `auth.<function>()` in RLS policies are being unnecessarily re-evaluated for each row
detail: Table `public.customers` has a row level security policy `Customers can read their own row` that re-evaluates auth.uid() for each row. This produces suboptimal query performance at scale. Resolve the issue by replacing `auth.<function>()` with `(select auth.<function>())`.
